designDeviations.planner_check: acceptable, or say so and the filter is removed with fixture (b) marked unable to fire

designDeviations.what: tier-1 binding among several authoritative aliases for one key is earliest knowledgeAt first (then validFrom, then nodeId); later nodes are MERGED_INTO the earliest.
designDeviations.why: Today's [...nodeIds][0] is hydration order, which is DB row order with no ORDER BY. Earliest-known preserves what pass one has been doing whenever the DB returned insertion order, so published node ids for re-run counties do not move (V9). Consequence named for the planner: counties with random-era aliases (48055 has four sets per key by the card's arithmetic; Bastrop 3.18) keep binding to the earliest random-era node, not to the deterministic one; changing that is a repoint decision, not this card.

designDeviations.what: persisted aliases per chunk are the chunk's emitted set, deduplicated only by the aliases conflict target (alias_key, valid_from, knowledge_at).
designDeviations.why: Literal reading of item 1. Consequence: every run at a new knowledgeAt inserts one era row per key even when the binding is unchanged, so the aliases table keeps growing one set per run (the 247,397-row Bastrop symptom continues). Reusing the earliest era when the binding is unchanged would stop that; not done here because it changes era semantics. Named as a planner decision.
